lines.t: These roots, these roots been crying out so long
I've wandered down these dust-worn roads
Tradition heavy on my spine
Been chasing echoes in the halls
Lost between the pages searching for a sign
Statues of empty memory
Holding names that aren't divine
My soul aches for waters deeper
The living well, the truest mind
Every hurdle in my mind comes crashing
Like thunder breaking up the night
I hear a whisper, sweet and gentle
Calling me to give up every fight
Ain't no salvation in a picture
No truth in someone else's name
I left the old illusion splinter
Let holy fire cleanse my shame
These roots are crying out
Let my heart be new
Strip these idols from my spirit
Let the real shine through
Empty me, don't let me hide
Plant me deep in Yahushua's sight
I remember sacred letters
How their words would pull me home
A faith not born of man's traditions
But the grace I find alone
Truth is more than words we borrow
Love is more than how we pray
To trust and follow hope and sorrow
Obey with love, not fear today
The accuser softly hissing
But I'm learning not to bend
With honesty I face the darkness
Let the truth become my friend
I humble this proud vessel
With fasting and with tears
Confessing every desperate weakness
Till perfect love dries every fear
Lay down the broken pieces
Let the silence heal the soul
Let mercy rise inside me and
Make the pieces whole
I still the angry waters, I wait for morning's light
His love reshapes my shadow, turns blindness into sight
These roots are crying out, let my heart be new
Strip these idols from my spirit
Let the real shine through
Empty me, don't let me hide
Play me deeper, yeah, who should sigh?
Perfect in love and broken weakness
Learning as I go
To walk that narrow trembling highway
And let the true roots grow
Each honest word a healing
Each step a buried pride
I'm drawing from that holy wellspring
With the Mashiach as my guide
